sizing_summary: Workshop output (initial): recommend reserved pool = 6 x H100-equivalent GPUs for steady-state to cover 60 QPS with expected model mix (chat + summarization) and KV-cache fractions
Peak capacity: add 2-4 burst GPUs (spot/burst) to absorb regional events up to 300 QPS; autoscale policy with warm-standby routing

Model assumptions used in sizing: Llama2-13B quantized variant for chat, specialized encoder for reranking; measured median token/sec per GPU ~900-1,400 depending on prompt lengths and KV cache hit rate
Estimated reserved throughput: 6 GPUs -> ~9k-12k tps baseline (aligns with steady-state), burst pool + autoscale -> headroom to ~50k tps for <30 minutes windows
Cache strategy: 30-45% prefix/KV cache effectiveness expected; reduces steady token/sec by ~35% in common flows
Recommended SLOs for contract: p95 latency target 350ms, p99 1.2s, availability 99.95% for Dedicated cluster; define separate SLA for burst periods and fallbacks
